author: Parsifal-2045
body:
This PR proposes to disable Eigen debug code CMSSW-wide. Local tests have shown a significant impact on kernel `STACK` usage, with reductions ranging from ~20% to >90%.
Kernel timing also shows improvements, with kernels in the CA chain (and the on-device Broken Line fit) benefiting the most (~40% overall timing reduction, corresponding to ~3% of the total GPU time in a typical Phase-2 HLT reconstruction job).

For reference, the total kernel time (as reported by `nsys`) running the Phase-2 HLT reconstruction on 1000 TTbar events with 200 PU looks like this (tested on a single `NVIDIA H100 NVL MIG 1g.12gb`):

Metric | Debug enabled | `EIGEN_NO_DEBUG` | Change
|:-------------:|:-------------:|:-------------:|:-------------:|
Total GPU kernel time | 63.93  0.23 s | 62.20  0.23 s  | 2.7  0.5%
17 affected kernels | 4189  19 ms  | 2453  10 ms | 41.4  0.4%
Other 95 kernels | 59'745  226 ms | 59'750  227 ms | +0.01  0.54% 

While the stack size as reported by `cudaKernelStackBudget` (same GPU so for `sm_90` shows large decreases of STACK reservation for the kernels in the BL fit family.
For reference, running `cudaKernelStackBudget --launched --verbose phase2_HLT.py` before results in: 
```
CUDA kernel stack-frame memory budget
  scheduled modules using CUDA libraries: 6
  CUDA libraries from the configuration:  4
  extra libraries scanned from the run:   6
  kernels inspected:                      244452
  kernels actually launched (CUPTI):      112 (108 matched to stack data)

device 0: NVIDIA H100 NVL MIG 1g.12gb (compute capability 9.0, sm_90)
  max resident threads: 32768
  reservation (launched kernels): 51.0 MiB (53477376 B) = 32768 threads x 1632 B
      largest stack frame 1632 B in pluginRecoTrackerPixelSeedingPortableCudaAsync.so
      kernel: alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<6, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
      shared memory: 1024 B total = 1024 B static + 0 B dynamic
  static upper bound (config's CUDA libraries): 347.8 MiB (364642304 B)
  spilling kernels (43):
    STACK   1632 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<6, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
    STACK   1552 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<5, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
    STACK   1296 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<4, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
    STACK   1184 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<3, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
    STACK    512 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::caHitNtupletGeneratorKernels::Kernel_find_ntuplets<pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
```
With the new flag, we get:
```
CUDA kernel stack-frame memory budget
  scheduled modules using CUDA libraries: 6
  CUDA libraries from the configuration:  4
  extra libraries scanned from the run:   6
  kernels inspected:                      244420
  kernels actually launched (CUPTI):      112 (108 matched to stack data)

device 0: NVIDIA H100 NVL MIG 1g.12gb (compute capability 9.0, sm_90)
  max resident threads: 32768
  reservation (launched kernels): 39.5 MiB (41418752 B) = 32768 threads x 1264 B
      largest stack frame 1264 B in pluginRecoTrackerPixelSeedingPortableCudaAsync.so
      kernel: alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<6, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
      shared memory: 1024 B total = 1024 B static + 0 B dynamic
  static upper bound (config's CUDA libraries): 262.2 MiB (274989056 B)
  spilling kernels (43):
    STACK   1264 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<6, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
    STACK   1200 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<5, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
    STACK    976 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<4, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
    STACK    848 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::Kernel_BLFit<3, pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
    STACK    512 B  LOCAL      0 B  SHARED   1024 B  DYN      0 B  REG 255  alpaka_cuda_async::caHitNtupletGeneratorKernels::Kernel_find_ntuplets<pixelTopology::Phase2OT>  [hltPhase2PixelTracksSoA]
```

I have not performed the full set of validation tests and only tested and compiled a limited number of locally checked-out packages.
title: Add `EIGEN_NO_DEBUG` flag to `CMS_EIGEN_CXX_FLAGS`
